reviewed_by: Codex focused review of goal linked-turn validation and lifecycle
reason: Three collected Python cases cover persistence and completion of the 10,001st linked goal turn, ordinary goal linkage and charging, and automatic continuation. Three collected real-Core browser entries cover the operator goal lifecycle through the production UI on LAN in desktop Chromium, emulated mobile Chromium, and emulated mobile WebKit.
exclusions: No frontend or native implementation changed, so their unit suites are excluded. Unrelated Python and browser journeys are excluded. The browser journey covers normal goal controls; the 10,001st-turn boundary is verified by the focused durable Core regression. No physical-device test is available.
